spec.objective: Create the NEW pure helper module harness/redpair_vcmd_guard.py exposing references_sibling_oracle(vcmd, oracle_files) -> bool, the substring predicate the plan_normalizer wireup will consult to detect a genuine fix-forward red-pair vcmd.

oracle_files contains ints/None mixed with strings -> non-str entries skipped, no raise.
An empty-string entry in oracle_files never matches even though '' in vcmd is truthy.

Does NOT touch plan_normalizer.py (that is the wireup leaf).
Does NOT perform path resolution, globbing, or any filesystem access — it is a pure substring predicate.

acceptance_criteria: Inside _sanitize_impl_verification_commands, the set of qualifying oracle files is computed once per call: for every test_authoring task with a mutation_target whose _module_path(mutation_target) EXISTS under repo_root (skipped entirely when repo_root is None), that oracle's files_touched entries are added.

spec.objective: Wire the pure red-pair guard into the planner's last impl-vcmd sanitize pass so a genuine fix-forward red-pair vcmd (referencing a sibling oracle whose mutation_target resolves to a real on-disk module) is never rewritten to a vacuous import or an unrelated existing-test pytest run.
functional_requirements: Import references_sibling_oracle from harness.redpair_vcmd_guard at module top of plan_normalizer.py.

In _sanitize_impl_verification_commands, before the per-impl loop, compute the qualifying-oracle-file set: for each test_authoring task (via _is_test_authoring) with a mutation_target (via _mutation_target) whose _module_path(mutation_target) exists under repo_root, add its _files_touched entries; when repo_root is None compute no qualifying files (the guard is inert, preserving backward compat).

In the per-impl loop, immediately before the existing-test rewrite branch (line 274) and the vacuous rewrite branch (line 277), if references_sibling_oracle(vcmd, qualifying_files) is True, continue without modifying the vcmd.
spec.interfaces: Reuse existing helpers _module_path (line 25), _files_touched (line 34), _mutation_target (line 42), _is_test_authoring (line 46). Path existence: (Path(repo_root) / _module_path(mt)).exists(). New import: from harness.redpair_vcmd_guard import references_sibling_oracle.

Oracle has no mutation_target -> does not qualify; impl vcmd still vacuous-ized.
Oracle's mutation_target resolves to an absent module (e.g. pkg/absent.py) -> does not qualify; impl vcmd still rewritten.
An unrelated tests/**/test_<leaf>.py exists on disk for the impl module -> the guard's continue must short-circuit BEFORE the existing-test rewrite so a genuine red-pair vcmd is never rewritten.
